flow flow.clock v1
title: Clock watch
start: settle
stage watch: Watch
step settle [Timer] Settle until the due time
  stage: Watch
  does: Waits until `due`.
  next: When the time comes: go to Hold for a ping
step hold [Wait for an event] Hold for a ping
  stage: Watch
  does: Waits for the event `clock.ping`.
  next: When the event arrives: go to Released
  onTimeout: If no answer arrives by `due`: go to Expired
step released [End] Released
  stage: Watch
  does: Ends the case with the result Released.
step expired [End] Expired
  stage: Watch
  does: Ends the case with the result Expired.
